text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right! I have to be happy!
choice_data_list: It's not like you to sigh like that.
It's rare to hear you sigh like that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...But still,
my body can't fake it. I really
do feel a
lot more tired than usual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If my physical condition's not great, my
luck won't be either! First, I need to get
plenty of rest so I
can get my energy
back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Copano Rickey is worn
out. I should
probably adjust her race
schedule.
